items.name: lifecycle-diagram
items.title: Lifecycle Diagram
items.description: Theme-aware, read-only lifecycle diagram using React Flow and ELK. Shows the current state, actual execution history, available transitions and optional end markers, with clickable state/transition details.
items.docs: Pass description.description from useLifecycle/createLifecycleHook, currentState from view.record, availableTransitions filtered from view.available, and history from view.history.transitions. History matches the exact transition/source/destination; current state alone never implies a visited path. Pass a translated endLabel for separate decorative markers on explicit final states. For detailed page diagrams use direction DOWN and autoHeight. Translate ariaLabel, stateLabel and transitionLabel; append a gear to automatic transition labels if needed. Edges are solid with inline labels and subdued neutral strokes; current/visited/available highlights use the application primary theme token. Current nodes have a stronger fill and ring, visited nodes a light fill, with no extra visited label. onStateClick/onTransitionClick open details and never fire transitions. Keep toMermaid for documentation/export.

items.name: workflow-management
items.title: Workflow Management
items.description: Workflow administration as presentational parts: one management page with Definitions and Executions tabs, a categorized definition list, a filtered execution list, definition diagram and parameter layout, and execution history inspection beside a diagram. Wire it to application-owned routes, data and permissions.
items.docs: Install @nocobase/workflow-management and read @nocobase/workflow-management-demo. Render WorkflowManagementLayout around the application Outlet with URL-controlled Definitions and Executions tabs; declare sidebar navigation only on the Workflow management parent. Pass adapted rows, translated labels, search/category controls, status/empty content and callbacks to WorkflowDefinitionList and WorkflowExecutionList. WorkflowDefinitionDetail places the diagram beside an application-owned parameter form. WorkflowExecutionDetail takes transition/effect records and a renderDiagram callback receiving the selected history prefix and current state; render with @nocobase/lifecycle-diagram or an existing compatible diagram. It never executes transitions or saves configuration. Keep API fetching, URL query state, permissions, parameter persistence, recovery actions and breadcrumbs in the application. All wording comes from props; no example plugin or backend is installed.
